model_annotations.English: The pie chart displays the distribution of data across three years: 2017, 2018, and 2019. It is divided into three colored segments, each representing a year and its corresponding percentage and count. The largest segment, colored blue, represents 2019 and accounts for 46.0% (46 items). The orange segment represents 2018, comprising 33.0% (33 items), and the green segment represents 2017, making up 21.0% (21 items). The segments are arranged in descending order of size, starting with 2019 at the top, followed by 2018 to the left, and 2017 to the right. Each segment includes both the percentage and the absolute count in parentheses, and the years are labeled outside the chart near their respective slices. There is no legend, but the colors and labels are clearly associated with each year. The chart visually emphasizes the dominance of 2019 over the other two years.
model_annotations.German: The pie chart displays the distribution of data across three years: 2017, 2018, and 2019. It is divided into three colored segments, each representing a year and its corresponding percentage and count of occurrences. The largest segment, colored blue, represents 2019 and accounts for 46.0% (46 items). The orange segment represents 2018, making up 33.0% (33 items), and the green segment represents 2017, comprising 21.0% (21 items). The segments are arranged in descending order of size, starting with 2019 at the top, followed by 2018 to the lower left, and 2017 to the lower right. Each segment includes its percentage and numerical count inside, and the years are labeled adjacent to their respective slices. There is no legend, but the colors and labels are clearly associated with each year.
